query: I'm adding .github/workflows/lint.yml that runs on pull_request and push. Before I commit it, can you check whether it should have a paths filter? It only runs eslint on src/ and the root package.json

our Actions bill jumped 40% last month and I think half the workflows fire on every README edit. can you go through .github/workflows and tighten the triggers so they only run when something they use changed?

I moved e2e/checkout.spec.js to tests/e2e/checkout.spec.js yesterday and now the Playwright workflow never runs on spec changes. I think its paths: list still points at the old folder, can you find every workflow that has this problem?
audit all our workflows for missing path filters. we have 14 of them in .github/workflows and I suspect most trigger on docs-only PRs
I want to make the `build` job a required status check, but it has paths: on the workflow. what's the right way to keep the filter's savings without blocking docs-only PRs forever?
just added a new step to ci.yml that runs scripts/check-licenses.sh. does ci.yml's paths filter need updating? it currently lists src/** and package.json only

docs-only PRs are running the full 25 minute test matrix. add paths-ignore for the stuff that doesn't matter (README, docs/, LICENSE) to the pull_request trigger in test.yml, and make sure the workflow file itself still counts as salient
The deploy workflow filters on package.json but we bumped a dependency through package-lock.json only and nothing deployed. Is the filter wrong? check the other workflows for the same hole
review .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml: it triggers on push to main with no path filter, and it builds an image from services/api. what should its salient paths be?

we have a required check called `unit` that's currently skipped when only markdown changes, and it's blocking merges on those PRs. How do I restructure the workflow so it reports green quickly instead?
the nightly cron in .github/workflows/backup.yml didn't fire last night. Why would a schedule trigger get skipped?
my workflow pins actions/checkout to a tag. Can you convert every uses: line across our workflows to a full commit SHA?
The e2e job is taking 18 minutes. Help me shard the Playwright tests across 4 runners and cache the browser download
CI is red on my PR: 'Process completed with exit code 1' in the build step. Here's the log, can you figure out what failed?
set up branch protection on main so PRs need one approval and the unit check to pass, as a ruleset I can apply with gh api
write a new GitHub Actions workflow that runs pytest on Python 3.11 and 3.12 for every pull request
How do I pass a secret from one reusable workflow to the caller job without printing it in the logs?
Explain the difference between pull_request and pull_request_target and when each one is safe to use with fork PRs
Add a CODEOWNERS file so that anything under .github/workflows needs review from the platform team
write a shell script that lists all the open PRs in our org older than 30 days and posts them to Slack
